title: Couldn't get it warm enough
text: Couldn't get it warm enough. The fragrance is quite nice, and the fabric is soft, but despite my every effort I simply could not get it warm enough to be the least bit helpful for my achy lower back.  Possibly I can get some use out of it by combining it with the heating pad, but I had hoped this pillow would be a substitute for it, not an addition.  :-(((

description: Give the gift of well-being and comfort to yourself or someone in need of a little heartfelt nurturing. DreamTime's Healing Heart Pillow is an object of both beauty and caring, symbolizing all that is loving and good. Providing localized relief with either a warm or cool touch, it can be used as an effective spot treatment for a host of discomforts. Whether it's a bad bump or bruise that needs a cooling touch, or an achy, sore muscle or tummy that needs a warming caress, the Healing Heart Pillow will nurture and care for all your tender spots. Adorned in plush velvet and filled with our exclusive blend of the natural herbs cinnamon, clover and eucalyptus, the Heart Pillow delivers an aroma and aura of serenity and comfort.
